```http
GET /v1/inbound
```

## Authentication

Send a server-side API key: `Authorization: Bearer $NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY`. See [Authentication](/docs/authentication).

Required scope: `inbound:read`.

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `q` | query | string | no | Search text. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | default `50`. minimum 1. maximum 100. |
| `offset` | query | integer | no | default `0`. minimum 0. |

<Tab value="Go">

```go
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_URL")+"/v1/inbound", nil)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("NJIWA_MAIL_API_KEY"))
	res, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer res.Body.Close()
	out, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
	fmt.Println(res.StatusCode, string(out))
}
```

## Responses

### 200

A page of inbound messages

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `has_more` | boolean | no | &nbsp; |
| `limit` | integer | no | &nbsp; |
| `offset` | integer | no | &nbsp; |
| `items` | array of object | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].id` | string (uuid) | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].address_id` | string (uuid) | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].envelope_from` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].envelope_to` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].header_from` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].subject` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].spam_score` | number | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].raw_size` | integer | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].received_at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].retention_expires_at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].bodies_purged_at` | string (date-time) | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].attachment_count` | integer | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].project` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].mode` | "sandbox" \| "live" | no | &nbsp; |
| `items[].in_reply_to` | string (uuid) | no | The id of the outbound message this answers, when known. |

### 401

invalid_api_key. The response carries `WWW-Authenticate`.

Header `WWW-Authenticate`: string

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_api_key"
  }
}
```

### 403

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ip_not_allowed"
  }
}
```

## Error codes

Errors share one shape: `error.code` is stable, `error.message` is optional detail. Retry only timeouts, network errors, `429` and `5xx`, with the same idempotency key; fix the request for every other `4xx`.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `invalid_api_key` | 401 | Missing, wrong, revoked or expired key |
| `ip_not_allowed` | 403 | The caller's address is not on the key's allowlist |
| `missing_scope` | 403 | The key lacks the scope this call needs |

Every code is explained on [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
